The entire production makes for an excellent primer on the history of dance in both stage and film. It is fantastically executed and is not to be missed.
No one is suggesting that Gotta Dance! is anything more than what it is, an enjoyable evening of dance numbers culled from mostly familiar Broadway shows and a few movie musicals.
This show had me captivated every minute of its runtime.
Their commitment, precision, and sheer joy in movement carry the evening through its less defined stretches.
Dancing and choreography are both just beautiful.

cn.t: Critics celebrate "Gotta Dance!" as a captivating, high-energy showcase of Broadway choreography that keeps audiences engaged throughout, with top-flight dancing and vibrant performances bringing theatrical dance history to life.

vr.q: If you love Broadway dance, and I mean really love it, there's no reason not to see this show. It is a masterclass in what choreography can do when it's in service of storytelling.
